tables_1.title:
Insulation test.

Measure the insulation resistance of Heaters, Generator stator winding and Excitation field. Use 500 volts' megger and the value should not be less than 1 MOhms. Record the visual inspection observations and insulation measurement in Table No. 1.

Table no_1

cells.value: Insulation resistance of Stator winding > 1 MOhms.
Insulation resistance of Excitation field > 1 MOhms.
